release.featureStage: R6.8 plus Discord raid signup menu

coveredScenarios: One public signup button; both character and manual modes always available
Native modal select fields and Checkbox false preserved
No signup before confirmation; role editable in either mode
Durable opt-out before website registration; inherited upon registration and subsequent login
Concurrent registration and anonymous preference update in both orders
Atomic signup, preference and draft commit; replay/owner/expiry/revision protection
Stale menu cannot overwrite a newer signup or global preference
Manual signup allowed without RL approval even with mandatory minimum ilvl
All nine legacy signup ID families open new menu without writing signup
DM opt-out checked after Discord queue wait; database failure prevents sending
Authenticated own-account API with origin, body and impersonation protection
Signed bot HTTP form opens directly; modal submit persists before deferred acknowledgement

runtime.dependencyOverlay: Same security overlay as 3.8.85; dependency pins unchanged

buildWarnings.description: Existing dynamic filesystem tracing warnings in discordWelcomeCard.ts

validationNotes: A restored local Turbopack persistence cache contained incomplete temporary SST files. Preserved it separately and completed the build with a fresh cache; no production configuration change.
Static CI guards updated to track the new menu handler while retaining public message recovery and stale-circuit write protections.
limits: No live PostgreSQL or Firestore integration; transaction tests use controlled storage with rollback and read-before-write enforcement
No live Discord messages or Blizzard mutations
No visual verification in a live Discord client
R6.9, R7 and R8 remain unfinished
